basis: Tinker training at $0.44 per million tokens: 1.02M, 1.03M and 1.00M; reading at $0.195 per million prefill and $0.65 per million generated: 282,332 prefill, 2,046 generated
name: Few-mention: the ignore and heed arms at seed 1, and plain with the same start read but not trained (plain_masked)
result: The ignore arm replicates at seed 1 (the corrected job named in 30 of 30 one-word answers; raw r 0.67 against 0.78 at seed 0) and the heed arm too (unknown 30 of 30). Plain documents with the same start read without training and no correction anywhere (one seed) sit where heed sits on the four-option and yes/no questions, so heed's position below plain there was the masking. Against that control, on the four-option question, text after a read correction that keeps the claim gives 0.82 and 0.74 of the full in-sentence run's shift, the same text edited to fit the correction -0.01 and 0.04. Exception: on 'Could X land the plane if both pilots fell ill?' after the correction, heed moves about as far as the full run (unexplained). Audited.
title: Training on Tinker (Qwen3-8B, LoRA rank 32, lr 2e-4, 20 documents per update, one pass; seed 1 for ignore and heed, seed 0 for plain_masked) and inference on the invented-men and Holloway items at update 50.
why: The two results audits of Sep 29 18:1x: does the ignore arm's disregard need the read correction, what does the masking alone do, and is either arm a one-seed accident? Gabriel, 18:26: 'yes, run 1 and 2'.
